name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 7.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 7, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 7, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 7, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on planning and designing programs
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on planning and designing programs

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence systems, on everyday life, including skilled trades
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence systems, on everyday life, including skilled trades

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 7, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the environment, and analyse ways to mitigate negative impacts and contribute to environmental sustainability
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the environment, and analyse ways to mitigate negative impacts and contribute to environmental sustainability

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of various technologies on the environment
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of various technologies on the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the effectiveness of various ways of mitigating the negative and enhancing the positive impact of human activities on the environment
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the effectiveness of various ways of mitigating the negative and enhancing the positive impact of human activities on the environment

specific_expectations.text: analyse how diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit practices and perspectives contribute to environmental sustainability
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse how diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit practices and perspectives contribute to environmental sustainability

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of interactions between and among biotic and abiotic components in the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of interactions between and among biotic and abiotic components in the environment

specific_expectations.text: explain that an ecosystem is a network of interactions among living organisms and their environment
specific_expectations.text_html: explain that an ecosystem is a network of interactions among living organisms and their environment

specific_expectations.text: identify biotic and abiotic components in an ecosystem, and describe the interactions between them
specific_expectations.text_html: identify biotic and abiotic components in an ecosystem, and describe the interactions between them

specific_expectations.text: describe roles and relationships between producers, consumers, and decomposers within an ecosystem
specific_expectations.text_html: describe roles and relationships between producers, consumers, and decomposers within an ecosystem

specific_expectations.text: describe the transfer of energy in a food chain, and explain the effects of altering any part of the chain
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the transfer of energy in a food chain, and explain the effects of altering any part of the chain

specific_expectations.text: describe how matter is cycled within the environment, and explain how the cycling of matter promotes sustainability
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how matter is cycled within the environment, and explain how the cycling of matter promotes sustainability

specific_expectations.text: explain the differences between primary succession and secondary succession in ecosystems
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the differences between primary succession and secondary succession in ecosystems

specific_expectations.text: explain how biotic and abiotic factors limit the number of organisms an ecosystem can sustain
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how biotic and abiotic factors limit the number of organisms an ecosystem can sustain

specific_expectations.text: describe how different approaches to agriculture and to harvesting food from the natural environment can impact an ecosystem, and identify strategies that can be used to maintain and/or restore balance to ecosystems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how different approaches to agriculture and to harvesting food from the natural environment can impact an ecosystem, and identify strategies that can be used to maintain and/or restore balance to ecosystems

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: evaluate the environmental and social impacts of the use and disposal of various pure substances and mixtures
overall_expectations.text_html: evaluate the environmental and social impacts of the use and disposal of various pure substances and mixtures

specific_expectations.text: analyse the social and environment impacts of the use and disposal of pure substances found in technological devices, considering local and global perspectives
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse the social and environment impacts of the use and disposal of pure substances found in technological devices, considering local and global perspectives

specific_expectations.text: assess environmental and social impacts of different industrial methods used to separate mixtures
specific_expectations.text_html: assess environmental and social impacts of different industrial methods used to separate mixtures

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the nature of matter, including the properties of pure substances and mixtures, and describe these properties using particle theory
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the nature of matter, including the properties of pure substances and mixtures, and describe these properties using particle theory

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the particle theory of matter
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the particle theory of matter

specific_expectations.text: use particle theory to distinguish between pure substances and mixtures
specific_expectations.text_html: use particle theory to distinguish between pure substances and mixtures

specific_expectations.text: distinguish between homogeneous and heterogeneous mixtures
specific_expectations.text_html: distinguish between homogeneous and heterogeneous mixtures

specific_expectations.text: use the particle theory to describe how different factors affect the solubility of a substance and the rate at which it dissolves
specific_expectations.text_html: use the particle theory to describe how different factors affect the solubility of a substance and the rate at which it dissolves

specific_expectations.text: describe the concentration of a saturated solution in both qualitative and quantitative terms, and differentiate between saturated and unsaturated solutions
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the concentration of a saturated solution in both qualitative and quantitative terms, and differentiate between saturated and unsaturated solutions

specific_expectations.text: explain why water is referred to as the universal solvent
specific_expectations.text_html: explain why water is referred to as the universal solvent

specific_expectations.text: explain various processes used to separate mixtures, including solutions, into their components, and identify some applications of these processes
specific_expectations.text_html: explain various processes used to separate mixtures, including solutions, into their components, and identify some applications of these processes

specific_expectations.text: describe pure substances as elements and compounds consisting of atoms and combinations of atoms
specific_expectations.text_html: describe pure substances as elements and compounds consisting of atoms and combinations of atoms

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: analyse personal, social, economic, and environmental factors that should be considered when designing and building structures
overall_expectations.text_html: analyse personal, social, economic, and environmental factors that should be considered when designing and building structures

specific_expectations.text: evaluate environmental, social, and economic factors that should be considered when designing and building structures to meet specific needs for individuals and communities
specific_expectations.text_html: evaluate environmental, social, and economic factors that should be considered when designing and building structures to meet specific needs for individuals and communities

specific_expectations.text: evaluate the impact of the ergonomic design of various tools, objects, and work spaces on a user’s health, safety, and ability to work efficiently, and use this information to describe changes that could be made in their own spaces and activities
specific_expectations.text_html: evaluate the impact of the ergonomic design of various tools, objects, and work spaces on a user’s health, safety, and ability to work efficiently, and use this information to describe changes that could be made in their own spaces and activities

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between structural forms and the forces acting on them
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between structural forms and the forces acting on them

specific_expectations.text: classify structures as solid structures, frame structures, or shell structures
specific_expectations.text_html: classify structures as solid structures, frame structures, or shell structures

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which the centre of gravity of a structure affects the structure’s stability
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which the centre of gravity of a structure affects the structure’s stability

specific_expectations.text: identify the magnitude, direction, point of application, and plane of application of the forces applied to a structure
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the magnitude, direction, point of application, and plane of application of the forces applied to a structure

specific_expectations.text: describe the role of symmetry in structures, and identify instances of symmetry in various structures
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the role of symmetry in structures, and identify instances of symmetry in various structures

specific_expectations.text: describe factors that can cause a structure to fail
specific_expectations.text_html: describe factors that can cause a structure to fail

specific_expectations.text: identify the factors that determine the suitability of materials for use in manufacturing a product or constructing a structure
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the factors that determine the suitability of materials for use in manufacturing a product or constructing a structure

specific_expectations.text: describe methods engineers and other professionals use to assess, improve, and maintain the safety of structures
specific_expectations.text_html: describe methods engineers and other professionals use to assess, improve, and maintain the safety of structures

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss, and analyse various social and environmental impacts of the use of energy from renewable and non-renewable sources
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss, and analyse various social and environmental impacts of the use of energy from renewable and non-renewable sources

specific_expectations.text: assess the social and environmental benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss in enclosed spaces or heat transfer to surrounding spaces
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the social and environmental benefits of technologies that reduce heat loss in enclosed spaces or heat transfer to surrounding spaces

specific_expectations.text: analyse various social, economic, and environmental impacts, including impacts related to climate change, of using non-renewable and renewable sources of energy
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse various social, economic, and environmental impacts, including impacts related to climate change, of using non-renewable and renewable sources of energy

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 7, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of heat as a form of energy that is associated with the movement of particles and is essential for many natural processes within Earth’s systems
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of heat as a form of energy that is associated with the movement of particles and is essential for many natural processes within Earth’s systems

specific_expectations.text: use particle theory to explain how heat affects the motion of particles in a solid, a liquid, and a gas
specific_expectations.text_html: use particle theory to explain how heat affects the motion of particles in a solid, a liquid, and a gas

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of various ways in which heat is generated
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of various ways in which heat is generated

specific_expectations.text: use particle theory to explain the effects of heat on volume in solids, liquids, and gases, including during changes of states of matter
specific_expectations.text_html: use particle theory to explain the effects of heat on volume in solids, liquids, and gases, including during changes of states of matter

specific_expectations.text: explain how heat is transmitted through conduction, and describe natural processes that are affected by conduction
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how heat is transmitted through conduction, and describe natural processes that are affected by conduction

specific_expectations.text: explain how heat is transmitted in liquids and gases through convection, and describe natural processes that depend on convection
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how heat is transmitted in liquids and gases through convection, and describe natural processes that depend on convection

specific_expectations.text: explain how heat is transmitted through radiation, and describe the effects of radiation from the Sun on different kinds of surfaces
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how heat is transmitted through radiation, and describe the effects of radiation from the Sun on different kinds of surfaces

specific_expectations.text: describe the role of radiation in heating and cooling Earth, and explain how greenhouse gases affect the transmission of radiated heat through the atmosphere
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the role of radiation in heating and cooling Earth, and explain how greenhouse gases affect the transmission of radiated heat through the atmosphere

specific_expectations.text: identify common sources of greenhouse gases, including sources resulting from human activity, and describe how humans can reduce emissions of these gases
specific_expectations.text_html: identify common sources of greenhouse gases, including sources resulting from human activity, and describe how humans can reduce emissions of these gases
